# SlowArrayOperationsInLoop

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Performance](/rules/#performance) · PhpStorm name: `SlowArrayOperationsInLoopInspection`

Two loop anti-patterns:

- **Accumulating merges**: `$acc = array_merge($acc, $chunk)` inside a loop
  copies the whole accumulator on every iteration (quadratic cost). Collect
  the chunks and merge once after the loop.
- **Length in a `for` condition**: `$i < count($items)` re-evaluates the
  length on every iteration. Compute it once in the initialiser.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{7,8,10,27,28,29,30} [Before]
<?php
function collect(array $batches, $repo)
{
    $all = [];
    $map = [];
    foreach ($batches as $batch) {
        $all = array_merge($all, $batch);
        $map = \array_replace($batch, $map);
        try {
            $repo->rows = array_merge_recursive($repo->rows, $batch);
        } finally {
        }
    }
    while ($batch = array_shift($batches)) {
        $map[$batch['id']] = array_merge($map[$batch['id']], $batch);
        if ($batch) {
            $all = array_merge($all, $batch);
        }
        $other = array_merge($all, $batch);
    }
    foreach ($batches as $batch) {
        $all = array_merge($all, $batch);
        break;
    }
    $all = array_merge($all, $map);

    for ($n = 0; $n < count($batches); $n++) {}
    for ($n = 0, $m = 1; strlen($repo->name) >= $n; $n++) {}
    for ($repo->at = 0; $repo->at <= mb_strlen($repo->name); $repo->at++) {}
    for (; count($batches) > $n; $n++) {}
    for ($n = 0, $total = count($batches); $n < $total; $n++) {}
    for ($n = 0; $n < count($batches) - 1; $n++) {}
    for ($n = 0; ; $n++) {}
    return [$all, $map];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function collect(array $batches, $repo)
{
    $all = [];
    $map = [];
    foreach ($batches as $batch) {
        $all = array_merge($all, $batch);
        $map = \array_replace($batch, $map);
        try {
            $repo->rows = array_merge_recursive($repo->rows, $batch);
        } finally {
        }
    }
    while ($batch = array_shift($batches)) {
        $map[$batch['id']] = array_merge($map[$batch['id']], $batch);
        if ($batch) {
            $all = array_merge($all, $batch);
        }
        $other = array_merge($all, $batch);
    }
    foreach ($batches as $batch) {
        $all = array_merge($all, $batch);
        break;
    }
    $all = array_merge($all, $map);

    for ($n = 0, $nMax = count($batches); $n < $nMax; $n++) {}
    for ($n = 0, $m = 1, $nMax = strlen($repo->name); $nMax >= $n; $n++) {}
    for ($repo->at = 0, $loopsMax = mb_strlen($repo->name); $repo->at <= $loopsMax; $repo->at++) {}
    for ($nMax = count($batches); $nMax > $n; $n++) {}
    for ($n = 0, $total = count($batches); $n < $total; $n++) {}
    for ($n = 0; $n < count($batches) - 1; $n++) {}
    for ($n = 0; ; $n++) {}
    return [$all, $map];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 7: &#39;array_merge(...)&#39; inside a loop re-copies the accumulator each time; merge once after the loop.</li>
<li>line 8: &#39;array_replace(...)&#39; inside a loop re-copies the accumulator each time; merge once after the loop.</li>
<li>line 10: &#39;array_merge_recursive(...)&#39; inside a loop re-copies the accumulator each time; merge once after the loop.</li>
<li>line 27: &#39;count(...)&#39; is re-evaluated on every iteration; compute it once before the loop.</li>
<li>line 28: &#39;strlen(...)&#39; is re-evaluated on every iteration; compute it once before the loop.</li>
<li>line 29: &#39;mb_strlen(...)&#39; is re-evaluated on every iteration; compute it once before the loop.</li>
<li>line 30: &#39;count(...)&#39; is re-evaluated on every iteration; compute it once before the loop.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SlowArrayOperationsInLoop": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SlowArrayOperationsInLoop

/**
 * @noinspection SlowArrayOperationsInLoopInspection
 */
```
